speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pregnant patient presenting with vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain. To ensure the safety of you and the fetus, can you please tell me exactly how many weeks pregnant you are?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placental Abruption (suspected) at 38 weeks gestation. The history of prior cesarean section, sudden cessation of contractions with onset of severe pain and vaginal bleeding is highly suggestive of this condition; we must immediately assess fetal heart rate and maternal stability.
